comment: The PDFium build the engine is made for. scripts/fetch-pdfium.mjs downloads these files and refuses any whose SHA-256 differs. The 'pdfium_8125' feature of pdfium-render in crates/engine/Cargo.toml must match the release number. To update, follow docs/pdfium-updates.md: pick a release of bblanchon/pdfium-binaries, move the pdfium-render feature, and replace the checksums (compute them yourself from the downloaded files).
